## Interaction with the loop parameters (behavioral model today)

- Behavioral segment law today: CELL_X4_MIN=96 (24 ps×4) + step 1 ps×4 per
  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

S## Interaction with the loop parameters (behavioral model today)

- Behavioral segment law today: CELL_X4_MIN=96 (24 ps×4) + step 1 ps×4 per
  LSB, 64 cells/segment — the behavioral law need NOT match the real law;
  what must match is lock/loss detection scaling (LOCK_TOL 192/LOSS_TOL
  640 ps master) and the TDC quantization, both verified in
  `ddr1_ck90_dll_tdc_tb.v`. When the structural segment lands, the
  behavioral model parameters should be re-anchored to the measured
  chain-level curve for the jitter/pass-2 regressions.
- Real chain-level step at lock: 37–50 ps master per LSB (±9–13 ps CK90
  dither) vs LOCK_TOL 192 ps master — the lock band absorbs ±3-5 LSB of
  dither, comfortable.
- CODE_BITS drops 9 → 7 with the thermometer bank; CODE_INIT retargets to
  ~100 pending chain-level SPICE (see item 3 of the consequences above).
  The behavioral TBs force dly_off_x4 in the old units — the injection
  scaffolding is sim-only and unaffected by the remap.

## Chain-level SPICE results (2026-11-28, `flow/characterization/ddr1_dll_chain.py`)

Measured bare 6-element cascade, no tap/regenerator loads, wire cap 0.96 fF/node,
all corners, zero sim errors (`sim/outputs/ddr1/dll_chain/chain_custom.json`):

| code | SS ps | TT ps | FF ps |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 1122 | 668 | 432 |
| 32 | 1874 | 1115 | 761 |
| 64 | 2844 | 1713 | 1253 |
| 96 | 4078 | 2508 | 1919 |
| 112 | 4785 | 2964 | 2290 |
| 127 | 5500 | 3424 | 2652 |

**The interpolated single-element model was wrong in a dangerous direction**:
it predicted FF c127 ≈ 2818 ps (N=6); the bare chain measures 2652 ps. The
×1.2 interconnect estimate does not apply to a bare cascade (the isolated-
element measurement already included the loads the cascade re-counts).
Consequence: N=6 leaves only 6 codes of FF upward headroom before any
integration loading — **N=6 is dead**.

### Revised pick: N=8

| corner | lock code | headroom up | step@lock | CK90 dither |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SS | ~32 | 95 | ~40 ps/code | ±10 ps |
| TT | ~71 | 56 | ~32 ps/code | ±8 ps |
| FF | ~94 | 33 | ~29 ps/code | ±7 ps |

N=7 (41/82/106, FF headroom 21) is the minimum viable; N=8 costs +14% area
over it and buys real margin against integration loading — the bare-chain
measurement excludes end buffering and the slave-output driver.

### CODE_INIT = 48 (acquisition constraint)

With the structural TDC's correct-sign clamping, initial residuals must
only read the correct SIGN; positive residuals additionally must stay in
the unambiguous window (≤ +2920 ps at TT before falling-wavefront
interference). Master residual = 4×segment − 10000 ps:

| CODE_INIT | SS | TT | FF |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 32 | −6 | −4054 | −5941 |
| **48** | **+2580** | **−2459** | **−4629** |

CODE_INIT=48: every corner correct-sign, SS positive residual just inside
the +2920 window. CODE_INIT=32 is borderline-in-lock at SS (−6 ps — the
loop would declare lock almost immediately at a wrong point? NO: −6 ps is
INSIDE the lock band, so the loop would lock with master short by ~2 codes
worth of margin — actually it IS the lock point within quantization, fine
but pointless; the real objection is SS initial residual changes sign with
small element variation → unreliable acquisition direction).

### Driver: stock inv_4 chosen, SR regeneration becomes mandatory

Stock-driver chains match the custom INV4B driver within 1-3% on delay at
every measured point — the delay CHARACTERISTIC needs no custom cell.
BUT measured chain tpHL−tpLH asymmetry (input-rise to output-rise vs
input-fall to output-fall):

| corner@code | custom ps | stock ps |
|---|---:|---:|
| TT c64 | +296 | +665 |
| TT c127 | +232 | +940 |
| SS c64 | +280 | +841 |
| SS c127 | +92 | +1163 |

The custom balanced driver earns its keep on duty fidelity but not on
delay. Decision: **stock inv_4 both stages + matched SR regeneration**
(dll8_regen, already designed/measured by the SerDes session) at the
master and slave outputs. Rationale: the regeneration stage is OUTSIDE the
ratio path — matched copies at master and slave outputs cancel in the
loop (the TDC measures post-regen master; the loop servos the constant
shift out) and produce the CK90 duty independently of chain asymmetry.
This avoids the custom-cell collateral (no INV4B layout/liberty needed)
at the price of two small regeneration blocks. Verify: chain+regen SPICE
(pass-2), and the regeneration delay must be documented in the TDC
reference frame.

### Duty/asymmetry spec impact

The DDR1 requirement constrains only the CK90 PHASE (2.5 ns ±0.2), not its
duty — chain asymmetry is not a compliance violation. It eats the transmit
eye asymmetrically in `ddr_edge_out` though; the SR regeneration bounds it
to the regenerator's own residual asymmetry (dll8 measured ≤ a few ps per
stage). Documented as closed-by-construction pending the regen-chain
SPICE.

### N=8 direct measurement (2026-11-28, chain_n8_stock.json, 21/21 clean)

Confirms the extrapolation almost exactly — the chain law is linear in N:

| corner | lock code | headroom up | step@lock | c127 max | resid@CODE_INIT=48 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SS | 32.7 | 94 | 39.2 ps/code | 7311 ps | +2405 ps |
| TT | 71.6 | 55 | 31.0 ps/code | 4556 ps | −2570 ps |
| FF | 94.2 | 33 | 28.5 ps/code | 3538 ps | −4728 ps |

Monotonic in code at every measured point in every corner (the DQS-style
monotonicity requirement).  SS initial residual +2405 ps sits inside the
structural TDC's positive unambiguous window (+2920 ps); TT/FF negative
residuals clamp correct-sign at any depth — CODE_INIT=48 verified.
Chain asymmetry accumulates badly at depth 8/high codes (SS c96:
+1476 ps tpHL−tpLH) — confirms the SR regeneration is mandatory, not
optional.  CK90 bang-bang dither at lock: ±10/±8/±7 ps SS/TT/FF.

### Remaining chain-level verification (pass-2)

1. Chain + SR regeneration pulse fidelity (duty at output, edge rates,
   D_set, regen phase shift) — IN PROGRESS, flow/characterization/
   ddr1_dll_regen.py, full 32+8-element deck with m-collapsed fingers.
2. ~~N=8 confirmation run~~ DONE (table above).
3. **Integration loading — ANALYSED 2026-11-28 (closed by construction):**
   the ratio path is load-matched by topology, not by tuning:
   - CKIN drives the master's FIRST segment and the slave segment directly,
     so input loading (including the TDC measurement chain and the monitor)
     is common-mode between the 4-segment master and the 1-segment slave;
     it changes the absolute edge rate and therefore the LOCK CODE, never
     the 4:1 ratio.
   - Each segment output drives exactly one element input except the master
     END (drives the master regen latch) and the slave END (drives the CK90
     regen latch) — matched because both are the same cell.
   - The one real asymmetry was AFTER the latches: the master latch output
     drives the TDC offset chain while the CK90 latch output drives the EN
     gate + pad, and that difference is NOT divided by 4.  Fixed by adding a
     matched `sg13g2_buf_4` output stage inside every `DDR1_CLK_REGEN`
     instance (src/ddr1_dll_phys.v); the residual is the buffer's own load
     sensitivity, absorbed by TRIM_MASTER_PS.
   Consequence: integration loading cannot break the ratio, only shift the
   lock code (headroom 33-95 codes absorbs it) and the absolute systematic
   (TRIM).
4. ~~Mismatch~~ CLOSED analytically 2026-11-28: the SerDes session measured
   element-to-element matching at 1.5-1.7 ps sigma (same macro, same code;
   docs/dco_8phase_decision.md, good enough that per-element trim was
   dropped from silicon).  CK90 ratio error = slave_dev − master_dev/4
   with independent per-element errors: var = 8σ² + 32(σ/4)² = 10σ²,
   so σ(CK90) = √10 × 1.7 ≈ 5.4 ps, 3σ ≈ 16 ps against the ±100 ps target
   — 6.2× margin.  Caveat: cross-strip (master vs slave die-position)
   systematic gradients are NOT included in the same-macro measurement;
   layout must interdigitate/common-centroid the five segments, and the
   residual is bounded by the same order as the random term.  No Monte
   Carlo needed at this margin.

## Regenerated-chain SPICE (2026-11-28, `flow/characterization/ddr1_dll_regen.py`)

Full 32-element master + 8-element slave at the measured lock codes, 12-stage
reset pulse, matched `sg13g2_buf_4` output stages, 10 ps step, 4 decks.

| corner (code) | D_set master | D_set CK90 | regen mismatch | raw CK90 systematic |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SS (33) | 423.9 ps | 424.0 ps | **+0.1 ps** | +368 ps  |
| TT (72) | 272.7 ps | 283.8 ps | **+11.2 ps** | +255 ps |
| FF (94) | 196.8 ps | 198.6 ps | **+1.8 ps** | +198 ps  |

- **The two regenerators are matched** (0.1-11 ps).  That was the design
  premise ("matched SR regeneration at master and CK90") and it holds.
- **The raw systematic is out of spec at SS/TT** (+368/+255 ps vs ±200 ps):
  measuring the regenerated master leaves `(3/4)·D_set + D_EN` at CK90.
  `TRIM_MASTER_PS = 3·D_set + 4·D_EN` → **1472 / 1018 / 791 ps** at SS/TT/FF.
  A single fixed trim at the midpoint leaves ±85 ps CK90 across corners, so
  **TRIM must be corner-selected** — the locked CODE is a free corner sensor
  (SS/TT/FF lock at 33/72/94): three straps (or a code-indexed LUT) suffice.
- **CK90 duty at lock** = T/2 + D_reset − 1.5·D_set = **45.7% / 47.3% / 48.1%**
  (SS/TT/FF) — inside 45-55%, SS marginal.  (CK90 duty is not in the spec;
  this bounds the transmit-eye asymmetry.)

### Input-duty sensitivity of the deep master taps (found here, matters)

Same code, input duty 50% → 60% (TT):
`y8 −12 ps`, `x16 −40 ps`, `x24 −378 ps`, `x32` no clean edge.
The chain is ~1 period long, so pulse-width distortion (tpHL−tpLH) shrinks
the LOW phase with depth; at x24 it is ~2 ns, comparable to the settling
time, and the rising-edge delay becomes history-dependent.  In closed loop
that couples to CK90 as ≈ +137 ps per +10% input duty (the code compensates
the deep taps, the shallow slave barely moves).  The DLL input is the DE3
output, whose duty error is the MCK's attenuated 3×, so a 40/60% MCK gives
a 46.7/53.3% DLL input → ≈ ±45 ps CK90.  Bounded and acceptable, but it is
a real budget line: if the MCK duty is worse than 40-60%, budget more.
Mitigation if needed: a duty-cleaner on the DLL input (or characterize at
45/55 explicitly — the decks are in
`flow/characterization/run_ddr1_regen_sweep.sh`; they were queued but the
host was at load ~24 from a parallel P&R run, so the bound above rests on
the measured 50% and 60% points bracketing the range).
